items.title: UK SRS: Streamlining sustainability reporting and preparing for new requirements
items.summary: With the introduction of UK Sustainability Reporting Standards (UK SRS) and new reporting requirements for listed companies approaching, UK businesses face growing pressure to produce credible, consistent and decision-useful sustainability information.

items.title: ‘A sticking plaster’: Green economy warns of missed opportunities on energy and climate in Budget
items.summary: Chancellor John Healey has unveiled the 2026 Autumn Budget, prioritising “cheaper energy” with household bill relief and a move to shift policy costs off energy bills, but green groups say the package lacks the ambition needed to cut fossil fuel dependence.

items.title: The Government’s trick-or-treat approach to energy security is a horror story waiting to happen
items.summary: The Government’s approval of new oil and gas projects could become a Nightmare on Downing Street, with responses to energy security focused on treating symptoms rather than strengthening approaches to a clean energy transition.

items.title: Autumn Budget: Chancellor pledges energy reforms to cut bills but loosens biodiversity rules
items.summary: The Chancellor has announced a new energy cost-control framework, changes to renewable electricity contracts and the removal of biodiversity requirements on more brownfield sites in the Autumn Budget.

items.title: COP31: New AI Pledge ‘lacks teeth’ for climate action
items.summary: The Presidency has unveiled the Antalya Artificial Intelligence (AI) Pledge ahead of next month's summit, but industry experts have questioned whether the Pledge could effectively balance AI growth with climate protection.

items.title: EU tells countries to plan for 3C of warming under new climate resilience framework
items.summary: The European Commission has called on EU member states to plan for a world that is 3C warmer by 2100, setting a common global warming trajectory for governments to use when assessing climate risks and preparing for extreme weather.
